notes.title: Ender Story: Chapter 1 is out now!
notes.notes:
Just a quick announcement to let everybody know that Ender Story: Chapter 1 is out now on Steam!

Hopefully a few of you who wishlisted it over the past couple of weeks have picked up a copy because when better than when it's 30% off? I'll be keeping an eye on any reviews and feedback given so I can improve the worst aspects of Chapter 1 by the time Chapter 2 is out.

All the best,
Jordan
